---
title: "Research"
---

- [Multi-agent harness for attacking an open conjecture](HARNESS.md) — an architecture of role-separated agents (Scout, Strategist, isolated Provers, Refuter, blind Verifiers, Triage, Reviser, Formalizer, Weakener, Lifter, plus a persistent Ledger) built so errors decorrelate and no agent can see the reasoning trace behind the result it's checking. Motivated by the finding that in the largest published sweep of agent-claimed proofs of open problems, only 6.5% were meaningfully correct — most failures were a valid proof of a weaker or different statement. Includes the problem-contract template, the retreat/weakening protocol for descending to a provable special case, and file-based persistence so state survives across sessions rather than living only in a conversation.

Download the raw Markdown for the full harness, including the problem-contract template and per-role prompts.
